name: Azure DNS Zone Tampering
description: Azure DNS holds the names customers type in a browser. Changing or deleting a zone lets an attacker point mail and websites at servers they own, or take the company offline. That is useful for phishing on the real hostname and for intercepting password-reset email. Zone edits outside the DNS change process are a takeover attempt until proven otherwise.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
